name: Ector

attributes.attribute: brother of Lancelot and a knight of the Round Table

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ector is an Arthurian hero. Several figures of the Round Table bear this name. Ector the Wild Forest raises Lancelot as his own son. Ector de Maris is the brother of the great knight and rode beside him in Arthur's company.

okr.objective: Introduce the Arthurian name Ector as held by a brother and a foster father of Lancelot.
key_results: Ector de Maris is the brother of Lancelot and a knight.
Ector of the Wild Forest is Lancelot's foster father.
Several Round Table figures carry the name Ector.
